description: This file implements functions for managing a vector of objects to be deleted across data model providers, including initialization, destruction, adding objects, checking group consistency, and failure detection.

methods.name: GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a group_del_vector_t structure by setting its vector to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with a group_del_vector_t, including each entry's path and error message.

methods.name: GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AddObjectsToDelete
methods.description: Adds multiple object paths and group IDs to the delete vector, transferring ownership of path strings.

methods.name: GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AddObjectNotDeleted
methods.description: Adds an entry for an object that failed to delete, duplicating the path and error message.

methods.name: GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AreAllPathsTheSameGroupId
methods.description: Checks if all paths in the vector belong to the same data model provider group.

methods.name: GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_FindFirstFailureIfAllFailed
methods.description: Checks if all objects in a slice failed to delete and returns the first failure if so.
